paragraphs: The 335d was the flagship diesel in the F30/F31 3 Series range, powered by the N57 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel that offered a compelling blend of performance and economy. It was fitted from 2012 until 2018, when the 3 Series diesel range was restructured for the G20 generation. The N57 shares its basic architecture with BMW's other modular diesel engines, but features a sequential twin-turbo setup that gives the 335d its characteristically broad torque curve.
about.boldParagraph: The 335d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel fitted to the 335d from 2012 to 2018. This is a different engine family from the N47 fitted to smaller 3 Series diesels — the N57 is a six-cylinder design with its own characteristics and components. No confirmed known issue pattern has been independently verified for this specific application, but we replace timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.
